_case: P-code families with no rule of their own fall back to the engine zone
_why: Deliberately coarse: anything that is not ignition (P03), auxiliary emissions (P04) or transmission (P07/P08) lands here, so fuel/air metering and cooling share one bucket. Pinning it means a future narrowing of the fallback is a visible, intentional change rather than a silent one.

codes._why: Fuel system too lean, bank 1 — fuel/air metering
Cooling fan — inside the P04 range but not an emissions device
